source: S5 / rename and independent durability countercheck
status: checked; atomic path replacement supported, crash guarantee unsupported
checked_ranges: rename DESCRIPTION, renameat2 flags, EXDEV, BUGS
findings: Symlink replacement supported; nonempty directory replacement prohibited by plain rename; exchange available. Directory fsync needed to persist namespace mutations. NFS caveat is ambiguous outcome after failed RPC, not the asserted blanket loss of atomicity.

source: S7 / TUF and lighter signature alternative
status: checked; source supports principles, selected custom protocol underdefined
version: TUF security page modified 2024-10-12; live specification snapshot hashed, no numeric spec version asserted; live minisign documentation snapshot hashed
checked_ranges: specification 4.5 target-length/hash format and 5.1-5.2 update-time/trust-root conditions
findings: Signature trust, version freshness, expiry, size limits and key risk established. TUF binds target bytes with hashes, minisign signs selected file bytes. Candidate does not define signed-byte or content-digest contract, durable freshness floor, trusted offline clock or preview parity. These are planning limits rather than an executed exploit finding.
